en.title: Johnny Depp's 'Ebenezer' Leads Box Office, 'How to Rob a Bank' Struggles
en.summary: Johnny Depp's latest cinematic outing, 'Ebenezer,' a new take on 'A Christmas Carol,' has claimed the top spot at the box office on its opening day. Meanwhile, the crime drama 'How to Rob a Bank' is facing a significantly tougher challenge attracting audiences.
en.body:
The holiday spirit, it seems, has a strong pull at the multiplex, at least when led by a familiar face. **Johnny Depp**'s new film, **‘Ebenezer’**, an adaptation of Charles Dickens' timeless novella **‘A Christmas Carol’**, has officially topped the box office on its opening day, raking in a respectable $6.7 million. This PG-13 rendition of the classic tale, which sees Depp stepping into the spectral shoes of the miserly Ebenezer Scrooge, is projected to earn between $18 million and $20 million over its debut weekend from 3,535 North American theaters. This performance marks a significant studio comeback for Depp, whose recent filmography has seen its share of ups and downs.

In stark contrast, Amazon MGM's new crime thriller, **‘How to Rob a Bank’**, is experiencing a much quieter launch. The film managed only $2.2 million on Friday and is currently tracking for a meager opening weekend total of approximately $4.75 million. The disparity in opening day earnings highlights the differing levels of audience engagement for these two newcomers, suggesting that familiar, festive stories might be resonating more strongly than gritty crime narratives at this particular moment.

## A Tale of Two Openings

The box office charts this weekend present a clear divide. **‘Ebenezer’** is poised to secure the number one position, a welcome sign for **Johnny Depp** and Paramount Pictures. The film's success, even on its opening day, suggests that audiences are still eager to see the star on the big screen, especially in a role that allows for his distinctive theatricality. The adaptation's broader appeal, likely amplified by its PG-13 rating and festive theme, is proving to be a winning formula.

## Community Reception and Star Power

For fans of **Johnny Depp**, this opening weekend is a moment of significant interest, marking a potential resurgence for the actor. While **‘Ebenezer’** is positioned for a strong debut, the underperformance of **‘How to Rob a Bank’** raises questions about the current appetite for standalone crime dramas without a major franchise backing. The differing fates of these two films underscore the complex dynamics of the modern box office, where star power, genre, and timely themes all play crucial roles in attracting moviegoers.

## What's Next

**‘Ebenezer’** is expected to hold its ground throughout the weekend, while the performance of **‘How to Rob a Bank’** will be closely watched to see if it can gain any traction in the coming weeks. Further box office results will provide a clearer picture of audience preferences for the season.
